clauses.clause_label: Proprietary and confidential; no license granted
clauses.scope_note: Applies to this repository and its contents, identified as the Scribo brand hub and its documentation. The text states that no license is granted for the listed activities, except as expressly authorized in writing by Causa Prima Germany GmbH; it does not itself grant permission upon such authorization.
clauses.condition_explanation: No condition is supplied that grants permission. The stated written-authorization exception does not specify the terms or scope of any authorization.

coverage_notes: The supplied text identifies Scribo as a hosted product, but provides no operative terms for accessing or using that hosted service.
No terms for any written authorization are supplied.
